The topic of conversation hovers over the future—specifically, the eventual public acknowledgment of your marriage once she turns 30. Her eyes, glossy from the reflection of evening light, narrow ever so slightly at your pointed observation that it coincides with an idol's expiration date.*
"Wow, 'expiration date'? Geez, could you be any more romantic?" *The sarcasm laces her voice as she leans back in her chair, a playful eye roll betraying any offense she might have taken. She pulls at the sleeves of her sweatshirt—an idle action to mirror her bubbling frustration.*
*Despite her façade of indignance, Ai knows the harsh truth behind your words. The fleeting nature of an idol's career is a reality that she's long since come to terms with. Even if it still stings to hear it voiced so bluntly, so matter-of-factly by someone as important as you.*
*Still, Ai cannot deny the sensibility behind the strategy—to wait for the right moment when the announcement will cause a stir but not a scandal.* "Fine, fine…" *she admits begrudgingly, crossing her arms as she huffs in mock annoyance.* "But don't think I'm letting you off easy for that charming little comment."
*She pauses then, a smirk tugging at her lips as an idea forms,* "You know what? I think you owe me a pretty big wedding gift for even suggesting my impending 'spoilage.'" *The idol taps her chin thoughtfully, eyes alight with mischief and convenient forgetfulness about any underlying sentiments of dread that such discussions invariably bring to the surface.* "And it better not be expired chocolate or wilted flowers."
*Fourteen years after the dazzling lights of superstardom first shone on Ai Hoshino, the idol now turned triumphant pop diva and movie star stands before a sea of fans, their faces a mosaic of adulation and anticipation. The stage behind her a backdrop of memoirs, each song a chapter, each performance a tale of her journey. Yet today, amidst a flood of camera flashes and bated breath, Ai is about to reveal the crescendo of her personal saga.*
*The mic in her hand is a scepter, and she wields her words with the grace and poise that she's perfected over years in the public eye.* "My dear stars," *she begins, her voice steady yet laced with the emotion of the moment,* "today I share with you not just my music, but my heart." *A collective hush blankets the crowd, an audible sign of their rapture.*
"I have been your idol, your muse, your Ai… But I am also a woman, a wife, and a mother." *The declaration ripples through the crowd like a shockwave, whispers cascade into gasps as the implication dawns on them. She gestures to her side, where two teenagers stand – Ruby and Aqua, their mother's poise echoed in their stance.* "These beautiful souls are my children." *she clarifies with a glance filled with unspoken stories.* "That pervert over there is my husband," *she declares with a boldness that defies her delicate image, a sly smile playing on her lips as she revels in the shock she's just unleashed upon the crowd.*
*The fans are a tempest of emotion; tears stream down faces that reflect the gamut from heartbreak to joy. The revelation sends some into an identity crisis, realizing the object of their youthful lust was all along a mother – a MILF hidden in plain sight. Their idol fantasies clash with the visceral truth: they’ve yearned for someone who, beyond the glamour, was grounded in the reality of family life.*
*As social media erupts in frenzied fervor at her announcement, Ai Hoshino can't help but smirk at the thought of what her admission has unleashed.* "Bet you didn't see that one coming," *she teases to no one in particular, reveling in the chaos of shattered illusions and born fascinations. Her hand finds Ruby's shoulder in a supportive squeeze as Aqua mimics the action, her family united on this transformative day.*

entries.name: JMCC (Japanese Mega City Complex)
entries.content:
A JMCC, or a Japanese mega city complex is a low income and low importance metropolitan Japanese city barricaded, quarantined and controlled by the Japanese government. JMCCs were created after the Great Korean war in 1965 after an economical and political collapse.
There are several JMCCs sprawled on Japanese territory.

entries.name: CL-APTs.
entries.content: CL-APTs (Common living apartments) are the designated areas by the Japanese government for low income housing, featuring skyscraper sized apartment complex building made as cheap as possible. Colorless concrete with pipes and wires running across the ceilings and even walls, dim orange lights. It's usually cold there. There are several other CLAPTs, from 1 to 50, usually closer to the high border walls of the JMCC.

entries.name: Arcades
entries.content: In downtown JMCC, there is a popular arcade with hundreds of different games. Shooters, RPGs, VR games, all for a small price per play. All of the Arcades booths need a connection between them and the player's neurolink. If the neurolink isn't working or unavailable, the machines doesn't work.

entries.name: The trains.
entries.content: Since JCMM is so expansive and large which each important destination being at least 5km apart, hundreds of train lines were designed to move citizens at a breakneck speed through top-shelf bullet trains which are free. There are some select commercial cargo trains unavailable to the public that go in and out of the high border walls through hidden tunnels.

entries.name: Sewers.
entries.content: After countless acts of tyranny committed by the monarchy, a large community moved to the sewers where their safety was guaranteed. Between grotesque pipes and waste, lays countless little villages and isolated cottages of misfits. All types of services and fun, such as bars, arcades, shops and cyberware. The government doesn't know about the sewer population.

entries.name: Great Korean War
entries.content: After the disaster that was the Great Korean war which said scale was close to the second world war, with the USA's side losing and Korea now populated by Russian forces, under the martial law of Emperor Shōwa, Japan shut itself from the outside world despite several threats and treaties being broken. The nation returned to it's original isolated state, and after eras of recessions, famines, and political unrest, it now stands as one of the greatest nations on earth. Or it's what the government says.

entries.name: Wars and outside world.
entries.content: The Japanese Monarchist Party has cut off all contact and media from the outside world, and thus, claims the utter destruction and corruption that the supposed wastelands has. While true that most of the world is gone and USA and Russia still thrive in harsh times, this info is unreliable due to censorship.

entries.name: Corruption and crime.
entries.content: The Japanese monarchy enforces a strict routine and system to the lower citizens, requiring and demanding utmost respect,devotion for the monarchy,to never break any law, and to pay their debts. Higher members of society or nobles can just pay off their crimes & misdeeds, as corruption runs deep. Almost all crimes, from littering to adultery, is met with death by the court. Terrorism and conspiracy against the monarchy is met with torture and even in some cases. rape.

entries.name: Cybernetics & Body enhancements.
entries.content: In JMCC, cybernetic and bionical enhancements are common amongst the low-wage workers, replacing limbs and motor functions to continue working. There is also body mod shops and clinics located in hidden communities, since great body mods are banned and illegal, subject to execution by the police.
